verdict.rationale: Scheduled automations are a fair capability for a note-taking app, but the evidence documents no way for a user to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Reflect. The automatic daily note creation and Kindle sync are built-in behaviors, not user-defined schedules. Custom AI prompts are run manually, and Zapier is an external tool, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
